name: kicad-collab-web
description: React + TypeScript chrome for the KiCad Collaborative web editor (bundled into static/dist/ui.js)

scripts.build: npm run gen:version && node scripts/gen-icon-pack.js && node scripts/build-python.mjs && npm run build:canvas && npm run build:editor && npm run build:parts && npm run build:router && npm run build:landing && npm run build:github && npm run build:styleguide && npm run build:viewer3d && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:fab && esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --define:MENU_SPEC_SHARED=true --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --legal-comments=none && tailwindcss -i web/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --minify
scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-version.js && esbuild web/canvas/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=static/kicad-canvas.js --watch & esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --watch & tailwindcss -i web/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --watch & wait
scripts.test: cd static && for t in render perf shapes sch-tools pcb-tools router pcb-sizes props dialogs autoroute ctxmenus library schdialogs pcb-dialogs pad-model viewer3d menus pcb-qa themes fab; do node tests/$t.test.js || exit 1; done && cd .. && npm run test:review
scripts.build:canvas: esbuild web/canvas/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap --outfile=static/kicad-canvas.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'npm run build:canvas' from web/canvas/*.ts — edit the modules, not this file."

scripts.build:styleguide: esbuild web/styleguide/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=static/dist/styleguide.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'npm run build:styleguide' from web/styleguide/*.ts — edit the modules, not this file."
